description:
For one person, return their recent posts most relevant to what you post about — plus suggested talking points. Use before a warm comment or DM. Free — costs 0 credits.

Identify the person via *exactly one* of: `target_id` (a Constellation target — original input), `person_id` (a row in `people`), or `linkedin_url` (any form). The non-campaign forms work even when no Constellation campaign exists.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL (vanity or encoded form) — auto-resolved to a people row

person_id.description: people.id — when you already have the canonical person row

target_id.description: Constellation targets.id — for the original campaign-scoped flow
